title: Extension of scalars of a polynomial ring
statement: Let $A\to R$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $J$ a set. The map $R\otimes_AA[U_j:j\in J]\to R[U_j:j\in J]$, $r\otimes p\mapsto r\cdot\bar p$ ($\bar p$ the image of $p$ under the coefficient map $A\to R$), is an isomorphism of $R$-algebras; it sends $r\otimes1\mapsto r$ and $1\otimes U_j\mapsto U_j$. (Used with $A=\mathbf Z$.)
